```text
1	# Personal Site Agent Guide
2	
3	## Purpose
4	
5	This repository is the public publishing path for a personal site.
6	
7	The system is not a generic blog starter. It is a contract-driven pipeline:
8	
9	```text
10	Obsidian Vault
11	  -> tools/publisher
12	  -> content/public
13	  -> apps/web
14	  -> Vercel
15	```
16	
17	Any implementation work in this repo must preserve that boundary.
18	
19	---
20	
21	## Canonical Architecture
22	
23	### 1. Authoring Layer
24	
25	Source content lives in an Obsidian Vault outside this repository.
26	
27	This repo must not make the frontend read the Vault directly.
28	
29	### 2. Publisher Layer
30	
31	`tools/publisher` is the only adaptation layer between private authoring content and public site content.
32	
33	It is responsible for:
34	
35	- scanning configured Vault scopes
36	- parsing frontmatter
37	- filtering publishable entries
38	- resolving and copying assets
39	- rewriting Obsidian internal links to site routes
40	- exporting public markdown, metadata, and social drafts
41	
42	Do not move these responsibilities into `apps/web`.
43	
44	### 3. Public Snapshot Layer
45	
46	`content/public` is the frontend-facing content boundary.
47	
48	It contains:
49	
50	- `notes/`
51	- `courses/`
52	- `gallery/`
53	- `assets/`
54	- `metadata/`
55	- `social/`
56	
57	Treat this directory as generated output. Do not hand-edit exported documents as a normal workflow.
58	
59	### 4. Frontend Layer
60	
61	`apps/web` is the deployable site app.
62	
63	Current state:
64	
65	- Next.js 15 App Router shell with a typed content adapter over `content/public`
66	
67	Target state:
68	
69	- Next.js 15 App Router app with migrated domain routes and markdown presentation
70	
71	Its job is to consume the generated snapshot only:
72	
73	- list pages read `content/public/metadata/*.json`
74	- detail pages read `content/public/{notes|courses|gallery}/*.md`
75	- assets are served from exported `/assets/*`
76	
77	### 5. Deployment Layer
78	
79	Vercel deploys the frontend app after content has already been exported into `content/public`.
80	
81	The deployment target should not need direct Vault access or a database for the current scope.
82	
83	---
84	
85	## Migration Target
86	
87	The current migration target is:
88	
89	- replace Astro with Next.js 15 App Router
90	- preserve publisher contract
91	- preserve route families:
92	  - `/notes/[slug]`
93	  - `/courses/[slug]`
94	  - `/gallery/[slug]`
95	- keep metadata JSON as list-page source of truth
96	- keep exported markdown as detail-page source of truth
97	
98	The reference repo `guangzhengli/nextjs-blog-template` is a UI and App Router reference only.
99	
100	Do not blindly copy its blog-only information architecture.
101	
102	---
103	
104	## Target Next.js Runtime Split
105	
106	### A. Site Shell
107	
108	Purpose:
109	
110	- global layout
111	- global metadata
112	- typography, theme, navigation, footer
113	
114	Expected files:
115	
116	- `apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx`
117	- `apps/web/src/app/globals.css`
118	- `apps/web/src/components/header/*`
119	- `apps/web/src/lib/config.ts`
120	
121	### B. Content Adapter
122	
123	Purpose:
124	
125	- provide the only frontend read interface to `content/public`
126	- normalize metadata and markdown into typed runtime models
127	- expose list and detail loaders
128	
129	Expected files:
130	
131	- `apps/web/src/lib/content/types.ts`
132	- `apps/web/src/lib/content/paths.ts`
133	- `apps/web/src/lib/content/index.ts`
134	- `apps/web/src/lib/content/load-index.ts`
135	- `apps/web/src/lib/content/load-entry.ts`
136	- `apps/web/src/lib/content/normalize.ts`
137	
138	### C. Markdown Rendering
139	
140	Purpose:
141	
142	- render exported markdown consistently
143	- support GFM, code blocks, math, heading ids, TOC
144	- handle exporter-produced inline HTML safely
145	
146	Expected files:
147	
148	- `apps/web/src/components/markdown/*`
149	- `apps/web/src/lib/markdown/pipeline.ts`
150	- `apps/web/src/lib/toc.ts`
151	
152	### D. Route Pages
153	
154	Purpose:
155	
156	- home aggregation page
157	- domain list pages
158	- domain detail pages
159	- 404 handling
160	
161	Expected files:
162	
163	- `apps/web/src/app/page.tsx`
164	- `apps/web/src/app/notes/*`
165	- `apps/web/src/app/courses/*`
166	- `apps/web/src/app/gallery/*`
167	- `apps/web/src/app/not-found.tsx`
168	
169	### E. Secondary Outputs
170	
171	Purpose:
172	
173	- sitemap
174	- robots
175	- feeds
176	- comments
177	
178	Expected files:
179	
180	- `apps/web/src/app/sitemap.ts`
181	- `apps/web/src/app/robots.ts`
182	- `apps/web/scripts/generate-rss.js`
183	- `apps/web/src/components/giscus-comments.tsx`
184	
185	---
186	
187	## Rules For Implementation
188	
189	### Scope Rules
190	
191	- keep changes small and reviewable
192	- do not change publisher output shape unless a contract update is explicitly requested
193	- do not invent a second source of truth for content indexing
194	- do not collapse all content into a single `/blog` route family
195	
196	### Frontend Rules
197	
198	- prefer a markdown-first rendering pipeline over MDX-first assumptions
199	- keep route prefixes aligned with publisher rewriting logic
200	- if static assets must be copied into `apps/web/public`, treat that as packaging only
201	
202	### Testing Rules
203	
204	- publisher tests validate export behavior
205	- web tests should validate consumption behavior only
206	- each migration phase should end with the fastest relevant build or test check
207	
208	### Git Rules
209	
210	- ignore local build and dev artifacts such as `.astro/` and dev logs
211	- do not commit secrets or machine-local config
212	
213	---
214	
215	## Phase Purposes
216	
217	### Phase 0: Contract Freeze
218	
219	Purpose:
220	
221	- lock in what the frontend is allowed to consume
222	- prevent migration work from leaking into publisher redesign
223	
224	### Phase 1: Next.js Shell Bootstrap
225	
226	Purpose:
227	
228	- replace the Astro runtime shell with a minimal Next.js 15 app
229	- establish TypeScript, linting, styling, and app router entry points
230	- prove the new app can boot and build before content integration starts
231	
232	Primary output:
233	
234	- a static Next app with layout, globals, and placeholder home page
235	
236	### Phase 2: Typed Content Adapter
237	
238	Purpose:
239	
240	- rebuild current Astro content-loading behavior in a typed, reusable Next-compatible layer
241	- make lists and detail pages consume generated content through one internal API
242	
243	Primary output:
244	
245	- typed loaders for metadata indexes and markdown documents across notes, courses, and gallery
246	
247	### Phase 3: Route Migration
248	
249	Purpose:
250	
251	- replace Astro pages with Next route pages using the adapter
252	
253	### Phase 4: Markdown Presentation
254	
255	Purpose:
256	
257	- improve rendering quality and add TOC-capable markdown processing
258	
259	### Phase 5: Template UI Port
260	
261	Purpose:
262	
263	- port the reference template's layout and interaction strengths without importing its blog assumptions
264	
265	### Phase 6: SEO And Feeds
266	
267	Purpose:
268	
269	- add sitemap, robots, metadata, RSS/feed generation, and comments
270	
271	### Phase 7: Packaging And Cleanup
272	
273	Purpose:
274	
275	- remove Astro leftovers and make deployment deterministic
276	
277	---
278	
279	## Working Commands
280	
281	- Export content: `pnpm --dir tools/publisher export -- --config <config-path>`
282	- Test publisher: `pnpm --dir tools/publisher test`
283	- Run web app: `pnpm --dir apps/web dev`
284	- Build web app: `pnpm --dir apps/web build`
285	
286	If `pnpm` is unavailable on the current machine, validate the local package manager before continuing and switch to a working equivalent rather than blocking on tooling preference.
287	
288	---
289

1	# Publisher
2	
3	Content export pipeline for converting Obsidian vault content into public-safe format for the Next.js frontend.
4	
5	## Features
6	
7	- Frontmatter parsing and validation
8	- Asset path resolution and copying
9	- Obsidian internal link rewriting (`[[links]]` → standard markdown)
10	- Obsidian embed syntax support (`![[image.png|size]]`)
11	- Multi-channel export (site, wechat, xiaohongshu)
12	- Metadata index generation
13	
14	## Usage
15	
16	```bash
17	# Run with default config
18	pnpm --dir tools/publisher export
19	
20	# Run with custom config
21	pnpm --dir tools/publisher export -- --config config.yaml
22	```
23	
24	## Configuration
25	
26	Create a `config.yaml` file:
27	
28	```yaml
29	vault_root: "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault"
30	public_scope:
31	  include:
32	    - "08-个人/DKU相关"
33	    - "03-知识库"
34	  exclude:
35	    - "03-知识库/drafts"
36	output_root: "../../content/public"
37	default_channel: "site"
38	```
39	
40	## Content Requirements
41	
42	Markdown files must have this frontmatter to be exported:
43	
44	```yaml
45	---
46	title: "Your Title"
47	publish: true
48	content_type: note  # note, course, or artwork
49	channels:
50	  - site
51	summary: "Brief description"
52	tags:
53	  - tag1
54	  - tag2
55	---
56	```
57	
58	## Supported Content Types
59	
60	- `note` → exports to `content/public/notes/`
61	- `course` → exports to `content/public/courses/`
62	- `artwork` → exports to `content/public/gallery/`
63	
64	## Output Structure
65	
66	```
67	content/public/
68	├── assets/          # Copied images and media
69	├── notes/           # Exported notes
70	├── courses/         # Exported courses
71	├── gallery/         # Exported artwork
72	├── social/
73	│   ├── wechat/      # WeChat drafts
74	│   └── xiaohongshu/ # Xiaohongshu drafts
75	└── metadata/
76	    ├── notes.json   # Notes index
77	    ├── courses.json # Courses index
78	    └── gallery.json # Gallery index
79	```
80	
81	## Testing
82	
83	```bash
84	pnpm --dir tools/publisher test
85	```
86	
87	## Current Status
88	
89	- Fully functional export pipeline
90	- Tested with real Obsidian vault content
91	- Supports image embedding and link rewriting
92	- Generates metadata for frontend consumption
93
```
</details></tool-use>

1	# Frontmatter Helper - Obsidian 插件
2	
3	一键添加 frontmatter 到 Obsidian 笔记的插件。
4	
5	## 功能特性
6	
7	- ✅ 一键添加 frontmatter
8	- ✅ 自动推断标题、标签、摘要
9	- ✅ 自定义 frontmatter 内容
10	- ✅ 切换发布状态
11	- ✅ 支持多种内容类型（笔记、课程、作品）
12	- ✅ 支持多渠道发布（网站、微信、小红书）
13	
14	## 安装方法
15	
16	### 方法 1：手动安装
17	
18	1. 下载插件文件：
19	   - `manifest.json`
20	   - `main.js`
21	
22	2. 在 Obsidian 中打开设置：
23	   - 设置 → 第三方插件 → 已安装插件 → 打开插件文件夹
24	
25	3. 创建新文件夹：
26	   ```
27	   .obsidian/plugins/frontmatter-helper/
28	   ```
29	
30	4. 将下载的文件复制到该文件夹
31	
32	5. 重启 Obsidian
33	
34	6. 启用插件：
35	   - 设置 → 第三方插件 → 找到 "Frontmatter Helper" → 启用
36	
37	### 方法 2：从 Release 安装
38	
39	1. 下载最新 release 的 `frontmatter-helper.zip`
40	2. 解压到 `.obsidian/plugins/frontmatter-helper/`
41	3. 重启 Obsidian 并启用插件
42	
43	## 使用方法
44	
45	### 命令面板
46	
47	按 `Ctrl+P`（Windows/Linux）或 `Cmd+P`（macOS）打开命令面板，输入：
48	
49	- **添加 Frontmatter**：快速添加默认 frontmatter
50	- **添加 Frontmatter (自定义)**：打开自定义对话框
51	- **切换发布状态**：切换 `publish` 字段的 true/false
52	- **导出内容到网站**：运行 publisher 导出到 content/public
53	- **启动本地预览**：启动 Next.js 开发服务器
54	- **部署到 Vercel**：一键部署到 Vercel
55	
56	### 发布工作流
57	
58	1. 启动发布服务器：
59	   ```bash
60	   node tools/publish-server.js
61	   ```
62	2. 在 Obsidian 中使用命令面板执行：导出 → 预览 → 部署
63	
64	### 快捷键
65	
66	可以在设置 → 快捷键中为这些命令分配快捷键：
67	
68	- 推荐：`Ctrl+Shift+F` 为 "添加 Frontmatter"
69	- 推荐：`Ctrl+Shift+P` 为 "切换发布状态"
70	
71	### 侧边栏图标
72	
73	点击侧边栏的文件图标，快速添加 frontmatter。
74	
75	## Frontmatter 模板
76	
77	插件会自动推断以下内容：
78	
79	```yaml
80	---
81	title: "文章标题"  # 从第一个标题或文件名推断
82	publish: true      # 默认设置
83	content_type: note # 从目录结构推断
84	channels:
85	  - site           # 默认设置
86	summary: "文章摘要" # 从第一段内容推断
87	tags:
88	  - area/research  # 从目录结构推断
89	  - type/reference # 从目录结构推断
90	  - focus/pace     # 从子目录推断
91	---
92	```
93	
94	### 目录结构映射
95	
96	| 目录 | area 标签 | type 标签 |
97	|------|----------|----------|
98	| 01-研究项目 | area/research | type/reference |
99	| 02-课程学习 | area/course | type/course |
100	| 03-知识库 | area/knowledge | type/reference |
101	| 04-方法论 | area/method | type/method |
102	| 05-社团活动 | area/activity | type/activity |
103	| 06-创作 | area/creative | type/artwork |
104	| 07-归档 | area/archive | type/reference |
105	| 08-个人 | area/personal | type/reference |
106	
107	## 设置选项
108	
109	在设置 → Frontmatter Helper 中可以配置：
110	
111	- **默认发布状态**：新文章的默认 publish 值
112	- **默认内容类型**：新文章的默认 content_type
113	- **默认发布渠道**：新文章的默认 channels
114	- **自动推断标签**：是否根据路径自动推断 tags
115	- **自动推断摘要**：是否根据内容自动推断 summary
116	- **摘要最大长度**：自动推断摘要的最大字符数
117	
118	## 发布流程
119	
120	1. 在 Obsidian 中编写文章
121	2. 使用插件添加 frontmatter（或手动添加）
122	3. 设置 `publish: true`
123	4. 运行导出命令：
124	   ```bash
125	   cd tools/publisher && npm run export -- --config config.yaml
126	   ```
127	5. 本地预览：
128	   ```bash
129	   cd apps/web && npm run dev
130	   ```
131	6. 部署到 Vercel：
132	   ```bash
133	   vercel --prod
134	   ```
135	
136	## 常见问题
137	
138	### Q: 如何批量添加 frontmatter？
139	
140	A: 使用命令行脚本：
141	```bash
142	cd tools
143	node add-frontmatter.js --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault" --include "04-方法论"
144	```
145	
146	### Q: 如何修改已有的 frontmatter？
147	
148	A: 手动编辑文件开头的 YAML 块，或使用 "切换发布状态" 命令快速修改 publish 字段。
149	
150	### Q: 插件会修改我的文件内容吗？
151	
152	A: 只会在文件开头添加 frontmatter 块，不会修改正文内容。
153	
154	### Q: 如何自定义标签映射？
155	
156	A: 目前需要修改插件代码中的 `CATEGORY_MAP` 对象。未来版本会支持配置文件。
157	
158	## 开发
159	
160	### 本地开发
161	
162	1. 克隆仓库
163	2. 安装依赖：`npm install`
164	3. 构建：`npm run build`
165	4. 复制到 Obsidian 插件目录测试
166	
167	### 构建生产版本
168	
169	```bash
170	npm run build
171	```
172	
173	生成的文件在 `dist/` 目录。
174	
175	## 许可证
176

180

184	
185	### v1.0.0 (2026-05-27)
186	
187	- 初始版本
188	- 一键添加 frontmatter
189	- 自动推断标题、标签、摘要
190	- 自定义 frontmatter 对话框
191	- 切换发布状态命令
192	- 侧边栏图标
193	- 设置页面

1	#!/usr/bin/env node
2	/**
3	 * Publish Server - lightweight HTTP API for Obsidian plugin integration
4	 *
5	 * Endpoints:
6	 *   POST /api/export   - Export Obsidian notes to content/public
7	 *   POST /api/preview  - Start/stop local dev server
8	 *   POST /api/deploy   - Deploy to Vercel
9	 *   GET  /api/status   - Check server and service status
10	 *
11	 * Usage:
12	 *   node tools/publish-server.js [--port 3001]
13	 */
14	
15	import http from "node:http";
16	import { exec } from "node:child_process";
17	import path from "node:path";
18	import fs from "node:fs/promises";
19	import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
20	
21	const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
22	const PROJECT_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
23	const PORT = parseInt(process.argv.find((_, i, a) => a[i - 1] === "--port") || "3001", 10);
24	
25	let previewProcess = null;
26	
27	function readBody(req) {
28	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29	    const chunks = [];
30	    req.on("data", (c) => chunks.push(c));
31	    req.on("end", () => {
32	      try {
33	        resolve(JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString() || "{}"));
34	      } catch {
35	        resolve({});
36	      }
37	    });
38	    req.on("error", reject);
39	  });
40	}
41	
42	function runCommand(command, cwd) {
43	  return new Promise((resolve) => {
44	    exec(command, { cwd, shell: "powershell.exe", timeout: 120_000 }, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
45	      resolve({ ok: !error, stdout, stderr, code: error?.code ?? 0 });
46	    });
47	  });
48	}
49	
50	async function handleExport() {
51	  const configPath = path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, "tools", "publisher", "config.yaml");
52	  try {
53	    await fs.access(configPath);
54	  } catch {
55	    return { ok: false, error: "config.yaml not found" };
56	  }
57	
58	  const result = await runCommand(
59	    `node src/index.js --config config.yaml`,
60	    path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, "tools", "publisher")
61	  );
62	
63	  let exported = { site: 0 };
64	  try {
65	    const parsed = JSON.parse(result.stdout);
66	    exported = parsed.exported ?? exported;
67	  } catch {}
68	
69	  return {
70	    ok: result.ok,
71	    exported,
72	    stderr: result.stderr || undefined
73	  };
74	}
75	
76	async function handlePreview(action) {
77	  if (action === "start") {
78	    if (previewProcess) {
79	      return { ok: true, message: "Preview already running", port: 3000 };
80	    }
81	    const { spawn } = await import("node:child_process");
82	    previewProcess = spawn("pnpm", ["dev"], {
83	      cwd: path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, "apps", "web"),
84	      shell: "powershell.exe",
85	      stdio: "pipe"
86	    });
87	    previewProcess.on("exit", () => { previewProcess = null; });
88	    return { ok: true, message: "Preview starting on http://localhost:3000", port: 3000 };
89	  }
90	
91	  if (action === "stop") {
92	    if (previewProcess) {
93	      previewProcess.kill();
94	      previewProcess = null;
95	      return { ok: true, message: "Preview stopped" };
96	    }
97	    return { ok: true, message: "Preview was not running" };
98	  }
99	
100	  return { ok: true, running: !!previewProcess, port: 3000 };
101	}
102	
103	async function handleDeploy() {
104	  const result = await runCommand("vercel --prod --yes", PROJECT_ROOT);
105	  return {
106	    ok: result.ok,
107	    stdout: result.stdout,
108	    stderr: result.stderr || undefined
109	  };
110	}
111	
112	async function handleStatus() {
113	  return {
114	    ok: true,
115	    server: "running",
116	    preview: previewProcess ? "running" : "stopped",
117	    projectRoot: PROJECT_ROOT
118	  };
119	}
120	
121	const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
122	  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:${PORT}`);
123	  const method = req.method;
124	
125	  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
126	  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
127	  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS");
128	  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type");
129	
130	  if (method === "OPTIONS") {
131	    res.writeHead(204);
132	    res.end();
133	    return;
134	  }
135	
136	  let result;
137	  try {
138	    if (url.pathname === "/api/export" && method === "POST") {
139	      result = await handleExport();
140	    } else if (url.pathname === "/api/preview" && method === "POST") {
141	      const body = await readBody(req);
142	      result = await handlePreview(body.action ?? "status");
143	    } else if (url.pathname === "/api/deploy" && method === "POST") {
144	      result = await handleDeploy();
145	    } else if (url.pathname === "/api/status" && method === "GET") {
146	      result = await handleStatus();
147	    } else {
148	      res.writeHead(404);
149	      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "Not found" }));
150	      return;
151	    }
152	  } catch (err) {
153	    res.writeHead(500);
154	    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }));
155	    return;
156	  }
157	
158	  res.writeHead(result.ok ? 200 : 500);
159	  res.end(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
160	});
161	
162	server.listen(PORT, () => {
163	  console.log(`Publish Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
164	  console.log(`Endpoints:`);
165	  console.log(`  POST /api/export   - Export notes`);
166	  console.log(`  POST /api/preview  - Manage dev server`);
167	  console.log(`  POST /api/deploy   - Deploy to Vercel`);
168	  console.log(`  GET  /api/status   - Check status`);
169	});
170
```

1	#!/usr/bin/env node

3	import fs from "node:fs/promises";
4	import path from "node:path";
5	import process from "node:process";
6	
7	// Default frontmatter template
8	const DEFAULT_TEMPLATE = {
9	  publish: true,
10	  channels: ["site"],
11	  tags: []
12	};
13	
14	// Content type mapping based on directory
15	const CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
16	  "notes": "note",
17	  "courses": "course",
18	  "gallery": "artwork"
19	};
20	
21	// Category mapping based on directory structure
22	const CATEGORY_MAP = {
23	  "01-研究项目": { area: "research", type: "reference" },
24	  "02-课程学习": { area: "course", type: "course" },
25	  "03-知识库": { area: "knowledge", type: "reference" },

28	  "06-创作": { area: "creative", type: "artwork" },
29	  "07-归档": { area: "archive", type: "reference" },
30	  "08-个人": { area: "personal", type: "reference" }
31	};
32	
33	function parseArgs() {
34	  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
35	  const options = {
36	    vaultRoot: null,
37	    include: [],
38	    exclude: [],
39	    dryRun: false,
40	    force: false,
41	    template: {}
42	  };
43	
44	  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
45	    const arg = args[i];
46	
47	    if (arg === "--vault" && args[i + 1]) {
48	      options.vaultRoot = args[++i];
49	    } else if (arg === "--include" && args[i + 1]) {
50	      options.include = args[++i].split(",").map(s => s.trim());
51	    } else if (arg === "--exclude" && args[i + 1]) {
52	      options.exclude = args[++i].split(",").map(s => s.trim());
53	    } else if (arg === "--dry-run") {
54	      options.dryRun = true;
55	    } else if (arg === "--force") {
56	      options.force = true;
57	    } else if (arg === "--help" || arg === "-h") {
58	      console.log(`
59	Usage: node add-frontmatter.js [options]
60	
61	Options:
62	  --vault <path>      Path to Obsidian vault (required)
63	  --include <paths>   Comma-separated list of directories to include
64	  --exclude <paths>   Comma-separated list of directories to exclude
65	  --dry-run           Show what would be done without making changes
66	  --force             Overwrite existing frontmatter
67	  --help, -h          Show this help message
68	
69	Examples:
70	  node add-frontmatter.js --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault"
71	  node add-frontmatter.js --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault" --include "01-研究项目,04-方法论"
72	  node add-frontmatter.js --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault" --dry-run
73	`);
74	      process.exit(0);
75	    }
76	  }
77	
78	  if (!options.vaultRoot) {
79	    console.error("Error: --vault is required");
80	    process.exit(1);
81	  }
82	
83	  return options;
84	}
85	
86	async function listMarkdownFiles(rootPath, include = [], exclude = []) {
87	  const files = [];
88	
89	  async function scan(dir) {
90	    const entries = await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
91	
92	    for (const entry of entries) {
93	      const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
94	
95	      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
96	        // Check if directory should be excluded
97	        const relativePath = path.relative(rootPath, fullPath).replaceAll("\\", "/");
98	        if (exclude.some(ex => relativePath.startsWith(ex))) {
99	          continue;
100	        }
101	        await scan(fullPath);
102	      } else if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith(".md")) {
103	        // Check if file is in included directories
104	        const relativePath = path.relative(rootPath, fullPath).replaceAll("\\", "/");
105	        if (include.length > 0 && !include.some(inc => relativePath.startsWith(inc))) {
106	          continue;
107	        }
108	        files.push(fullPath);
109	      }
110	    }
111	  }
112	
113	  await scan(rootPath);
114	  return files;
115	}
116	
117	function inferTitle(filePath, content) {
118	  // Try to extract title from first heading
119	  const headingMatch = content.match(/^#\s+(.+)$/m);
120	  if (headingMatch) {
121	    return headingMatch[1].trim();
122	  }
123	
124	  // Use filename without extension
125	  const basename = path.basename(filePath, ".md");
126	  return basename;
127	}
128	
129	function inferContentType(filePath) {
130	  const relativePath = filePath.replaceAll("\\", "/");
131	
132	  for (const [dir, type] of Object.entries(CONTENT_TYPE_MAP)) {
133	    if (relativePath.includes(`/${dir}/`)) {
134	      return type;
135	    }
136	  }
137	
138	  return "note";
139	}
140	
141	function inferTags(filePath) {
142	  const relativePath = filePath.replaceAll("\\", "/");
143	  const tags = [];
144	
145	  // Add area tag based on top-level directory
146	  for (const [dir, category] of Object.entries(CATEGORY_MAP)) {
147	    if (relativePath.includes(`/${dir}/`)) {
148	      tags.push(`area/${category.area}`);
149	      tags.push(`type/${category.type}`);
150	      break;
151	    }
152	  }
153	
154	  // Add focus tag based on subdirectory
155	  const parts = relativePath.split("/");
156	  if (parts.length > 2) {
157	    const focus = parts[2].toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-");
158	    if (focus && !focus.startsWith(".")) {
159	      tags.push(`focus/${focus}`);
160	    }
161	  }
162	
163	  return tags;
164	}
165	
166	function inferSummary(content) {
167	  // Try to extract summary from first paragraph
168	  const lines = content.split("\n");
169	  let inFrontmatter = false;
170	  let summary = "";
171	
172	  for (const line of lines) {
173	    const trimmed = line.trim();
174	
175	    // Skip frontmatter
176	    if (trimmed === "---") {
177	      inFrontmatter = !inFrontmatter;
178	      continue;
179	    }
180	
181	    if (inFrontmatter) continue;
182	
183	    // Skip headings
184	    if (trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
185	
186	    // Skip empty lines
187	    if (!trimmed) continue;
188	
189	    // Use first non-empty paragraph as summary
190	    summary = trimmed;
191	
192	    // Limit length
193	    if (summary.length > 100) {
194	      summary = summary.substring(0, 97) + "...";
195	    }
196	
197	    break;
198	  }
199	
200	  return summary;
201	}
202	
203	function hasFrontmatter(content) {
204	  return content.startsWith("---\n") || content.startsWith("---\r\n");
205	}
206	
207	function buildFrontmatter(title, contentType, tags, summary) {
208	  const frontmatter = {
209	    title,
210	    publish: true,
211	    content_type: contentType,
212	    channels: ["site"],
213	    summary,
214	    tags
215	  };
216	
217	  const lines = ["---"];
218	
219	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(frontmatter)) {
220	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
221	      lines.push(`${key}:`);
222	      for (const item of value) {
223	        lines.push(`  - ${item}`);
224	      }
225	    } else if (typeof value === "string") {
226	      lines.push(`${key}: "${value.replace(/"/g, '\\"')}"`);
227	    } else {
228	      lines.push(`${key}: ${value}`);
229	    }
230	  }
231	
232	  lines.push("---");
233	  lines.push("");
234	
235	  return lines.join("\n");
236	}
237	
238	async function processFile(filePath, options) {
239	  const content = await fs.readFile(filePath, "utf8");
240	
241	  // Check if frontmatter already exists
242	  if (hasFrontmatter(content) && !options.force) {
243	    return { status: "skipped", reason: "frontmatter exists" };
244	  }
245	
246	  // Infer metadata
247	  const title = inferTitle(filePath, content);
248	  const contentType = inferContentType(filePath);
249	  const tags = inferTags(filePath);
250	  const summary = inferSummary(content);
251	
252	  // Build frontmatter
253	  const frontmatter = buildFrontmatter(title, contentType, tags, summary);
254	
255	  if (options.dryRun) {
256	    return {
257	      status: "would_update",
258	      title,
259	      contentType,
260	      tags,
261	      summary,
262	      frontmatter
263	    };
264	  }
265	
266	  // Remove existing frontmatter if force is true
267	  let newContent = content;
268	  if (hasFrontmatter(content) && options.force) {
269	    const endMarker = "\n---\n";
270	    const endIndex = content.indexOf(endMarker, 4);
271	    if (endIndex !== -1) {
272	      newContent = content.slice(endIndex + endMarker.length);
273	    }
274	  }
275	
276	  // Write new content with frontmatter
277	  await fs.writeFile(filePath, frontmatter + newContent, "utf8");
278	
279	  return {
280	    status: "updated",
281	    title,
282	    contentType,
283	    tags,
284	    summary
285	  };
286	}
287

289	  const options = parseArgs();

293	  console.log(`Exclude: ${options.exclude.length > 0 ? options.exclude.join(", ") : "none"}`);
294	  console.log(`Dry run: ${options.dryRun}`);

315

211	  // Infer content type from file path

226	  // Infer tags from file path
227	  inferTags(filePath) {
228	    const tags = [];
229	
230	    // Add area tag based on top-level directory
231	    for (const [dir, category] of Object.entries(CATEGORY_MAP)) {
232	      if (filePath.includes(`/${dir}/`)) {
233	        tags.push(`area/${category.area}`);
234	        tags.push(`type/${category.type}`);
235	        break;
236	      }
237	    }
238	
239	    // Add focus tag based on subdirectory
240	    const parts = filePath.split("/");
241	    if (parts.length > 2) {
242	      const focus = parts[2].toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-");
243	      if (focus && !focus.startsWith(".")) {
244	        tags.push(`focus/${focus}`);
245	      }
246	    }
247	
248	    return tags;
249	  }

251	  // Infer summary from content
252	  inferSummary(content) {
253	    const lines = content.split("\n");
254	    let inFrontmatter = false;
255	    let summary = "";
256	
257	    for (const line of lines) {
258	      const trimmed = line.trim();
259	
260	      // Skip frontmatter
261	      if (trimmed === "---") {
262	        inFrontmatter = !inFrontmatter;
263	        continue;
264	      }
265	
266	      if (inFrontmatter) continue;
267	
268	      // Skip headings
269	      if (trimmed.startsWith("#")) continue;
270	
271	      // Skip empty lines
272	      if (!trimmed) continue;
273	
274	      // Use first non-empty paragraph as summary
275	      summary = trimmed;
276	
277	      // Limit length
278	      if (summary.length > this.settings.summaryMaxLength) {
279	        summary = summary.substring(0, this.settings.summaryMaxLength - 3) + "...";
280	      }
281	
282	      break;
283	    }
284	
285	    return summary;
286	  }

293	      contentType,

300	      title,

302	      content_type: contentType,
303	      channels,
304	      summary,
305	      tags
306	    };
307	
308	    const lines = ["---"];
309	
310	    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(frontmatter)) {
311	      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
312	        lines.push(`${key}:`);
313	        for (const item of value) {
314	          lines.push(`  - ${item}`);
315	        }
316	      } else if (typeof value === "string") {
317	        lines.push(`${key}: "${value.replace(/"/g, '\\"')}"`);
318	      } else {
319	        lines.push(`${key}: ${value}`);
320	      }
321	    }
322	
323	    lines.push("---");
324	    lines.push("");
325	
326	    return lines.join("\n");
327	  }

405	        publishLineIndex = i;

185	async function resolveAssetSourcePath({ filePath, originalPath, vaultRoot }) {
186	  const directPath = path.resolve(path.dirname(filePath), originalPath);
187	  if (await pathExists(directPath)) {
188	    return directPath;
189	  }
190

193	  if (await pathExists(fallbackPath)) {

195	  }
196	
197	  const siblingEntries = await fs.readdir(path.dirname(filePath), {
198	    withFileTypes: true
199	  });
200	
201	  for (const entry of siblingEntries) {
202	    if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
203	    const candidatePath = path.join(path.dirname(filePath), entry.name, originalPath);
204	    if (await pathExists(candidatePath)) {
205	      return candidatePath;
206	    }
207	  }
208	
209	  if (vaultRoot) {
210	    const sharedPicDirectPath = path.join(vaultRoot, "pic", originalPath);
211	    if (await pathExists(sharedPicDirectPath)) {
212	      return sharedPicDirectPath;
213	    }
214	
215	    const sharedPicBaseNamePath = path.join(vaultRoot, "pic", path.basename(originalPath));
216	    if (await pathExists(sharedPicBaseNamePath)) {
217	      return sharedPicBaseNamePath;
218	    }
219	  }
220

222	}

242	    const keys = new Set([entry.slug, entry.frontmatter.title, relativePath, baseName]);
243	
244	    for (const key of keys) {

253	function rewriteInternalLinks(body, linkLookup) {

258	    if (!route) {

260	    }
261	
262	    const label = rawAlias ? rawAlias.trim() : normalizedTarget;
263	    return `[${label}](${route})`;
264	  });
265	}

267	function parseEmbedSize(value) {
268	  if (!value) return {};
269	  const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();

271	  if (/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {

273	  }
274	
275	  const dimensions = normalized.match(/^(\d+)x(\d+)$/);
276	  if (!dimensions) return {};
277	
278	  return {
279	    width: dimensions[1],
280	    height: dimensions[2]
281	  };
282	}

387	    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
388	      files.push(...(await listMarkdownFiles(fullPath)));
389	      continue;
390	    }
391	    if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith(".md")) {
392	      files.push(fullPath);
393	    }
394	  }
395	
396	  return files;
397	}
398	
399	function normalizeConfig(config) {
400	  const publicScope = config.publicScope ?? config.public_scope ?? {};
401	  return {
402	    vaultRoot: config.vaultRoot ?? config.vault_root,
403	    outputRoot: config.outputRoot ?? config.output_root,
404	    publicScope: {
405	      include: publicScope.include ?? [],
406	      exclude: publicScope.exclude ?? []
407	    }
408	  };
409	}
410	
411	async function loadConfigFromFile(configPath) {
412	  const raw = await fs.readFile(configPath, "utf8");
413	  const parsed = {};
414	  let activeObject = null;
415	  let activeTopLevelListKey = null;
416	  let activeNestedListKey = null;
417	
418	  for (const rawLine of raw.split("\n")) {
419	    if (!rawLine.trim() || rawLine.trim().startsWith("#")) continue;
420	    const indent = rawLine.match(/^ */)[0].length;
421	    const trimmed = rawLine.trim();
422	
423	    if (trimmed.startsWith("- ")) {
424	      if (indent === 2 && activeTopLevelListKey) {
425	        parsed[activeTopLevelListKey].push(parseScalar(trimmed.slice(2)));
426	        continue;
427	      }
428	      if (indent === 4 && activeObject && activeNestedListKey) {
429	        parsed[activeObject][activeNestedListKey].push(parseScalar(trimmed.slice(2)));
430	        continue;
431	      }
432	      continue;
433	    }
434	
435	    if (indent === 0) {
436	      const colonIndex = trimmed.indexOf(":");
437	      if (colonIndex === -1) continue;
438	      const key = trimmed.slice(0, colonIndex).trim();
439	      const rawValue = trimmed.slice(colonIndex + 1).trim();
440	
441	      if (!rawValue) {
442	        parsed[key] = [];
443	        activeTopLevelListKey = key;
444	        activeObject = null;
445	      } else {
446	        parsed[key] = parseScalar(rawValue);
447	        activeObject = null;
448	        activeTopLevelListKey = null;
449	      }
450	      activeNestedListKey = null;
451	      continue;
452	    }
453	
454	    if (indent === 2 && activeObject) {
455	      activeNestedListKey = null;
456	      const colonIndex = trimmed.indexOf(":");
457	      if (colonIndex === -1) continue;
458	      const key = trimmed.slice(0, colonIndex).trim();
459	      const rawValue = trimmed.slice(colonIndex + 1).trim();
460	      if (!rawValue) {
461	        parsed[activeObject][key] = [];
462	        activeNestedListKey = key;
463	      } else {
464	        parsed[activeObject][key] = parseScalar(rawValue);
465	      }
466	      continue;
467	    }
468	
469	    if (indent === 2 && activeTopLevelListKey) {
470	      if (Array.isArray(parsed[activeTopLevelListKey])) {
471	        parsed[activeTopLevelListKey] = {};
472	      }
473	      activeObject = activeTopLevelListKey;
474	      activeTopLevelListKey = null;
475	      activeNestedListKey = null;
476	      const colonIndex = trimmed.indexOf(":");
477	      if (colonIndex === -1) continue;
478	      const key = trimmed.slice(0, colonIndex).trim();
479	      const rawValue = trimmed.slice(colonIndex + 1).trim();
480	      if (!rawValue) {
481	        parsed[activeObject][key] = [];
482	        activeNestedListKey = key;
483	      } else {
484	        parsed[activeObject][key] = parseScalar(rawValue);
485	      }
486	    }
487	  }
488	
489	  return normalizeConfig(parsed);
490	}
491	
492	function buildExportFrontmatter(frontmatter, slug) {
493	  return {
494	    title: frontmatter.title,
495	    slug,
496	    content_type: frontmatter.content_type,
497	    summary: frontmatter.summary,
498	    tags: frontmatter.tags ?? [],
499	    cover: frontmatter.cover,
500	    created: frontmatter.created,
501	    updated: frontmatter.updated
502	  };
503	}
504	
505	function buildMetadataItem(frontmatter, slug) {
506	  return {
507	    title: frontmatter.title,
508	    slug,
509	    summary: frontmatter.summary ?? "",
510	    tags: frontmatter.tags ?? [],
511	    cover: frontmatter.cover ?? null,
512	    updated: frontmatter.updated ?? null,
513	    course: frontmatter.course ?? null,
514	    week: frontmatter.week ?? null,
515	    art_category: frontmatter.art_category ?? null,
516	    series: frontmatter.series ?? null
517	  };
518	}
519	
520	function shouldExclude(relativePath, excludeList) {
521	  return excludeList.some((excludedPath) => {
522	    const normalized = excludedPath.replaceAll("\\", "/");
523	    return relativePath === normalized || relativePath.startsWith(`${normalized}/`);
524	  });
525	}
526	
527	const ALL_CHANNELS = ["site", ...SUPPORTED_SOCIAL_CHANNELS];
528	
529	function resolveTagPublish(frontmatter) {
530	  const tags = Array.isArray(frontmatter.tags) ? frontmatter.tags : [];
531	  const tagChannels = [];
532	
533	  for (const tag of tags) {
534	    if (typeof tag !== "string") continue;
535	    const match = tag.match(/^publish\/(.+)$/);
536	    if (match && ALL_CHANNELS.includes(match[1])) {
537	      tagChannels.push(match[1]);
538	    }
539	  }
540	
541	  if (tagChannels.length === 0) return frontmatter;
542	
543	  const next = { ...frontmatter };
544	  if (next.publish !== true) next.publish = true;
545	  if (!Array.isArray(next.channels)) next.channels = [];
546	  for (const ch of tagChannels) {
547	    if (!next.channels.includes(ch)) next.channels.push(ch);
548	  }
549	  next.tags = tags.filter((t) => !t.startsWith("publish/"));
550	  return next;
551	}
552	
553	export async function runPublisher(inputConfig) {
554	  const config = normalizeConfig(inputConfig);
555	
556	  if (!config.vaultRoot || !config.outputRoot) {
557	    throw new Error("runPublisher requires vaultRoot and outputRoot.");
558	  }
559	
560	  const metadata = {
561	    notes: [],
562	    courses: [],
563	    gallery: []
564	  };
565	
566	  const result = {
567	    exported: {
568	      site: 0,
569	      social: {
570	        wechat: 0,
571	        xiaohongshu: 0
572	      }
573	    }
574	  };
575	
576	  const outputRoot = path.resolve(config.outputRoot);
577	  const siteDirectories = [
578	    "assets",
579	    "notes",
580	    "courses",
581	    "gallery",
582	    path.join("social", "wechat"),
583	    path.join("social", "xiaohongshu"),
584	    "metadata"
585	  ];
586	
587	  for (const directory of siteDirectories) {
588	    await removeAndRecreate(path.join(outputRoot, directory));
589	  }
590	
591	  const includeScopes = config.publicScope.include;
592	  const publishedEntries = [];
593	
594	  for (const includeScope of includeScopes) {
595	    const sourceDirectory = path.resolve(config.vaultRoot, includeScope);
596	    let markdownFiles = [];
597	
598	    try {
599	      markdownFiles = await listMarkdownFiles(sourceDirectory);
600	    } catch {
601	      continue;
602	    }
603	
604	    for (const filePath of markdownFiles) {
605	      const relativePath = path.relative(config.vaultRoot, filePath).replaceAll("\\", "/");
606	      if (shouldExclude(relativePath, config.publicScope.exclude)) {
607	        continue;
608	      }
609	
610	      const source = await fs.readFile(filePath, "utf8");
611	      const { frontmatter: rawFrontmatter, body } = parseFrontmatterDocument(source);
612	      const frontmatter = resolveTagPublish(rawFrontmatter);
613	
614	      if (frontmatter.publish !== true) continue;
615	      if (!Array.isArray(frontmatter.channels) || !frontmatter.channels.includes("site")) continue;
616	      if (!frontmatter.title || !frontmatter.content_type) continue;
617	
618	      const exportDirectoryName = TYPE_TO_DIRECTORY[frontmatter.content_type];
619	      if (!exportDirectoryName) continue;
620	
621	      const slug = frontmatter.slug ? slugify(frontmatter.slug) : slugify(frontmatter.title);
622	      if (!slug) continue;
623	
624	      publishedEntries.push({
625	        filePath,
626	        frontmatter,
627	        body,
628	        exportDirectoryName,
629	        slug
630	      });
631	    }
632	  }
633	
634	  const linkLookup = buildLinkLookup(publishedEntries, config.vaultRoot);
635	
636	  for (const entry of publishedEntries) {
637	      const { filePath, frontmatter, body, exportDirectoryName, slug } = entry;
638	      const rewrittenDocument = await rewriteAssetsInDocument({
639	        frontmatter,
640	        body,
641	        filePath,
642	        outputRoot,
643	        slug,
644	        vaultRoot: config.vaultRoot,
645	        linkLookup
646	      });
647	      const exportFrontmatter = buildExportFrontmatter(rewrittenDocument.frontmatter, slug);
648	      const outputMarkdown = `${serializeFrontmatter(exportFrontmatter)}${rewrittenDocument.body.trim()}\n`;
649	      const targetFile = path.join(outputRoot, exportDirectoryName, `${slug}.md`);
650	
651	      await fs.writeFile(targetFile, outputMarkdown, "utf8");
652	      result.exported.site += 1;
653	
654	      if (exportDirectoryName === "notes") {
655	        metadata.notes.push(buildMetadataItem(rewrittenDocument.frontmatter, slug));
656	      } else if (exportDirectoryName === "courses") {
657	        metadata.courses.push(buildMetadataItem(rewrittenDocument.frontmatter, slug));
658	      } else {
659	        metadata.gallery.push(buildMetadataItem(rewrittenDocument.frontmatter, slug));
660	      }
661	
662	      for (const channel of SUPPORTED_SOCIAL_CHANNELS) {
663	        if (!frontmatter.channels.includes(channel)) continue;
664	        const socialTarget = path.join(outputRoot, "social", channel, `${slug}.md`);
665	        await fs.writeFile(socialTarget, outputMarkdown, "utf8");
666	        result.exported.social[channel] += 1;
667	      }
668	  }
669	
670	  await fs.writeFile(
671	    path.join(outputRoot, "metadata", "notes.json"),
672	    JSON.stringify(metadata.notes, null, 2),
673	    "utf8"
674	  );
675	  await fs.writeFile(
676	    path.join(outputRoot, "metadata", "courses.json"),
677	    JSON.stringify(metadata.courses, null, 2),
678	    "utf8"
679	  );
680	  await fs.writeFile(
681	    path.join(outputRoot, "metadata", "gallery.json"),
682	    JSON.stringify(metadata.gallery, null, 2),
683	    "utf8"
684	  );
685	
686	  return result;
687	}

1	import { load } from "js-yaml";
2	
3	export type ParsedFrontmatterDocument = {
4	  frontmatter: Record<string, unknown>;
5	  body: string;
6	};
7	
8	export function parseFrontmatterDocument(source: string): ParsedFrontmatterDocument {
9	  if (!source.startsWith("---\n") && !source.startsWith("---\r\n")) {
10	    return { frontmatter: {}, body: source };
11	  }
12	
13	  const normalized = source.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
14	  const endMarker = "\n---\n";
15	  const endIndex = normalized.indexOf(endMarker, 4);
16	
17	  if (endIndex === -1) {
18	    return { frontmatter: {}, body: normalized };
19	  }
20	
21	  const rawFrontmatter = normalized.slice(4, endIndex);
22	  const body = normalized.slice(endIndex + endMarker.length).trim();
23	  const parsed = load(rawFrontmatter);
24	  const frontmatter =
25	    parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)
26	      ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>)
27	      : {};
28	
29	  return { frontmatter, body };
30	}
31

22	  let syncedCount = 0;
23	
24	  for (const file of files) {
25	    const sourcePath = path.join(SOURCE_DIR, file);
26	    const targetPath = path.join(TARGET_DIR, file);
27	
28	    if (fs.statSync(sourcePath).isFile()) {
29	      fs.copyFileSync(sourcePath, targetPath);
30	      syncedCount++;
31	    }
32	  }
33	
34	  console.log(`Synced ${syncedCount} assets from ${SOURCE_DIR} to ${TARGET_DIR}`);
35	}

8	const SITE_URL = "https://personal-site.vercel.app";

12	function loadMetadata(kind) {

18	function escapeXml(str) {
19	  return str

21	    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
22	    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
23	    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
24	    .replace(/'/g, "&apos;");
25	}

27	function generateItem(item, kind) {

29	    ? new Date(item.updated).toUTCString()
30	    : new Date().toUTCString();
31

33	      <title>${escapeXml(item.title)}</title>
34	      <link>${SITE_URL}/${kind}/${item.slug}</link>
35	      <guid isPermaLink="true">${SITE_URL}/${kind}/${item.slug}</guid>
36	      <description>${escapeXml(item.summary || "")}</description>
37	      <pubDate>${pubDate}</pubDate>
38	      <category>${kind}</category>
39	    </item>`;
40	}

45	  const gallery = loadMetadata("gallery");

49	    ...courses.map((item) => ({ ...item, kind: "courses" })),
50	    ...gallery.map((item) => ({ ...item, kind: "gallery" })),
51	  ].sort((a, b) => {
52	    const dateA = a.updated ? new Date(a.updated) : new Date(0);
53	    const dateB = b.updated ? new Date(b.updated) : new Date(0);
54	    return dateB.getTime() - dateA.getTime();
55	  });
56	
57	  const itemsXml = allItems
58	    .map((item) => generateItem(item, item.kind))
59	    .join("\n");
60	
61	  const feed = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
62	<rss version="2.0" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
63	  <channel>
64	    <title>${escapeXml(SITE_NAME)}</title>
65	    <link>${SITE_URL}</link>
66	    <description>${escapeXml(SITE_DESCRIPTION)}</description>
67	    <language>zh-CN</language>
68	    <lastBuildDate>${new Date().toUTCString()}</lastBuildDate>
69	    <atom:link href="${SITE_URL}/feed.xml" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/>
70	${itemsXml}
71	  </channel>

4	export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
5	  const baseUrl = "https://personal-site.vercel.app";
6	
7	  const [notes, courses, gallery] = await Promise.all([
8	    loadIndex("notes"),
9	    loadIndex("courses"),
10	    loadIndex("gallery"),
11	  ]);
12	
13	  const noteRoutes = notes.map((note) => ({
14	    url: `${baseUrl}/notes/${note.slug}`,
15	    lastModified: note.updated ? new Date(note.updated) : new Date(),
16	    changeFrequency: "weekly" as const,
17	    priority: 0.8,
18	  }));
19	
20	  const courseRoutes = courses.map((course) => ({
21	    url: `${baseUrl}/courses/${course.slug}`,
22	    lastModified: course.updated ? new Date(course.updated) : new Date(),
23	    changeFrequency: "weekly" as const,
24	    priority: 0.7,
25	  }));
26	
27	  const galleryRoutes = gallery.map((item) => ({
28	    url: `${baseUrl}/gallery/${item.slug}`,
29	    lastModified: item.updated ? new Date(item.updated) : new Date(),
30	    changeFrequency: "monthly" as const,
31	    priority: 0.6,
32	  }));
33	
34	  return [
35	    {
36	      url: baseUrl,
37	      lastModified: new Date(),
38	      changeFrequency: "daily",
39	      priority: 1,
40	    },
41	    {
42	      url: `${baseUrl}/notes`,
43	      lastModified: new Date(),
44	      changeFrequency: "daily",
45	      priority: 0.9,
46	    },
47	    {
48	      url: `${baseUrl}/courses`,
49	      lastModified: new Date(),
50	      changeFrequency: "weekly",
51	      priority: 0.8,
52	    },
53	    {
54	      url: `${baseUrl}/gallery`,
55	      lastModified: new Date(),
56	      changeFrequency: "weekly",
57	      priority: 0.7,
58	    },
59	    ...noteRoutes,
60	    ...courseRoutes,
61	    ...galleryRoutes,
62	  ];
63	}

1	export type TocItem = {
2	  id: string;
3	  text: string;
4	  level: number;
5	};
6	
7	export function extractTocFromHtml(html: string): TocItem[] {
8	  const toc: TocItem[] = [];
9	  const headingRegex = /<h([1-6])[^>]*id="([^"]*)"[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h[1-6]>/gi;
10	
11	  let match;
12	  while ((match = headingRegex.exec(html)) !== null) {
13	    const level = parseInt(match[1], 10);
14	    const id = match[2];
15	    const text = match[3].replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "").trim();
16	
17	    if (id && text) {
18	      toc.push({ id, text, level });
19	    }
20	  }
21	
22	  return toc;
23	}
24	
25	export function extractTocFromMarkdown(content: string): TocItem[] {
26	  const toc: TocItem[] = [];
27	  const lines = content.split("\n");
28	
29	  for (const line of lines) {
30	    const match = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/);
31	    if (match) {
32	      const level = match[1].length;
33	      const text = match[2].trim();
34	      const id = text
35	        .toLowerCase()
36	        .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "")
37	        .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
38	        .replace(/-+/g, "-")
39	        .trim();
40	
41	      if (id && text) {
42	        toc.push({ id, text, level });
43	      }
44	    }
45	  }
46	
47	  return toc;
48	}
49

10	export function Toc({ items }: TocProps) {
11	  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string>("");
12	
13	  useEffect(() => {
14	    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
15	      (entries) => {
16	        for (const entry of entries) {
17	          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
18	            setActiveId(entry.target.id);
19	          }
20	        }
21	      },
22	      { rootMargin: "-80px 0px -80% 0px" }
23	    );
24	
25	    for (const item of items) {
26	      const element = document.getElementById(item.id);
27	      if (element) {
28	        observer.observe(element);
29	      }
30	    }
31	
32	    return () => observer.disconnect();
33	  }, [items]);
34	
35	  if (items.length === 0) {
36	    return null;
37	  }
38	
39	  return (
40	    <nav className="sticky top-24 max-h-[calc(100vh-6rem)] overflow-y-auto">

49	          >

```text
1	# Runtime Overview
2	
3	## Repository Role
4	
5	This repository packages the public publishing path for a personal site.
6	
7	The runtime path is:
8	
9	`Obsidian Vault -> tools/publisher -> content/public -> apps/web -> Vercel`
10	
11	## Layer Responsibilities
12	
13	### `tools/publisher`
14	
15	This package is the adaptation layer between Obsidian-authored source files and the website.
16	
17	It is responsible for:
18	
19	- reading markdown files from configured Vault scopes
20	- parsing frontmatter
21	- filtering publishable content
22	- resolving relative assets and shared Vault image assets
23	- rewriting Obsidian links into site routes
24	- exporting markdown, metadata, assets, and social drafts
25	
26	### `content/public`
27	
28	This directory is the site-facing content boundary.
29	
30	It contains:
31	
32	- `notes/`, `courses/`, `gallery/`: exported markdown documents
33	- `assets/`: copied images and covers
34	- `metadata/`: JSON indexes for frontend listing pages
35	- `social/`: generated cross-posting drafts
36	
37	### `apps/web`
38	
39	This app is a lightweight Astro consumer of generated content.
40	
41	It is responsible for:
42	
43	- reading metadata and detail markdown from `content/public`
44	- rendering local preview pages
45	- serving as the deployable static site target for Vercel
46	
47	## Technology Stack
48	
49	- Publisher: `Node.js` with ESM JavaScript
50	- Site app: `Astro`
51	- Content format: `Markdown + frontmatter + JSON metadata`
52	- Deployment target: `Vercel`
53	
54	## Current Execution Model
55	
56	The site is built as a static-content pipeline.
57	
58	That means:
59	
60	- the Vault remains the authoring source
61	- the publisher produces a clean, public-safe content snapshot
62	- the frontend consumes generated files without needing direct Vault access
63	- deployment does not require a database for the current scope
64
```

1	# Personal Site Next.js Migration Reassessment
2	
3	> Reference UI/template baseline: [guangzhengli/nextjs-blog-template](https://github.com/guangzhengli/nextjs-blog-template)
4	> Goal: replace the Astro preview app with a Next.js 15 App Router site without breaking the existing publisher contract.
5	
6	---
7	
8	## 1. Reassessment Summary
9	
10	The previous migration plan had the right direction on framework choice, but it treated the reference repo as a direct blog template migration. That is not the architecture of this repository.
11	
12	The real shape of this repo is:
13	
14	```text
15	Obsidian Vault
16	  -> tools/publisher
17	  -> content/public
18	  -> apps/web
19	  -> Vercel
20	```
21	
22	That means the migration target is not "build a Next.js blog from markdown source". It is "build a Next.js runtime that consumes a generated public snapshot".
23	
24	### 1.1 What Must Stay
25	
26	- `tools/publisher` remains the only adaptation layer between Obsidian and the site.
27	- `content/public` remains the site-facing boundary.
28	- frontend must consume generated markdown, assets, and metadata only.
29	- route prefixes must stay aligned with publisher output:
30	  - `/notes/:slug`
31	  - `/courses/:slug`
32	  - `/gallery/:slug`
33	
34	### 1.2 What Should Change From the Old Plan
35	
36	#### Change 1: do not collapse everything into `/blog`
37	
38	The reference template is blog-centric, but this repo is not. Publisher already exports three content domains:
39	
40	- `notes`
41	- `courses`
42	- `gallery`
43	
44	Its internal-link rewriting also resolves to `/${directoryName}/${slug}`. If the new frontend rewrites everything into `/blog/[...slug]`, it breaks the contract already encoded in the exporter.
45	
46	#### Change 2: do not make Content Collections the primary index
47	
48	The old plan proposed Content Collections as the main content discovery mechanism. That creates a second indexing system on top of metadata JSON that the publisher already emits.
49	
50	For this repo, the better split is:
51	
52	- list pages read `content/public/metadata/*.json`
53	- detail pages read `content/public/{notes|courses|gallery}/*.md`
54	
55	This keeps the generated snapshot as the single public source of truth and avoids duplicating publisher responsibilities in the frontend.
56	
57	#### Change 3: do not force MDX-first architecture
58	
59	Publisher exports `.md`, not `.mdx`. It may also emit raw HTML such as sized `<img>` tags when converting Obsidian embeds. A markdown-first rendering pipeline is the correct default. MDX support can be added later only if authoring requirements change.
60	
61	#### Change 4: treat the template as a UI/reference donor, not an architecture donor
62	
63	The template is still useful for:
64	
65	- App Router structure
66	- `layout.tsx`, `robots.ts`, `sitemap.ts`
67	- header, TOC, comments, social icons
68	- design tokens and MDX/markdown presentation
69	- feed generation scripts
70	
71	But its content topology should not be copied verbatim.
72	
73	### 1.3 Recommended Architectural Direction
74	
75	Use Next.js 15 App Router for the runtime shell, but keep a lightweight filesystem adapter inside `apps/web` that reads the generated snapshot directly.
76	
77	In short:
78	
79	- borrow the template's UI shell
80	- keep this repo's exporter boundary
81	- add a typed content adapter layer inside the Next app
82	- phase features by contract-criticality, not by template completeness
83

290	## 4.2 Domain Model
291	
292	Use explicit content domains rather than a generic blog post abstraction.
293	
294	```ts
295	type ContentKind = "notes" | "courses" | "gallery";
296	
297	type ContentListItem = {
298	  kind: ContentKind;
299	  slug: string;
300	  title: string;
301	  summary: string;
302	  tags: string[];
303	  cover: string | null;
304	  updated: string | null;
305	  course?: string | null;
306	  week?: string | null;
307	  artCategory?: string | null;
308	  series?: string | null;
309	};
310	
311	type ContentDocument = ContentListItem & {
312	  body: string;
313	  created?: string | null;
314	  contentType?: string | null;
315	};
316	```
317	
318	Two important decisions:
319	
320	1. `kind` should be injected by the frontend adapter based on source directory or metadata file, not inferred from markdown frontmatter alone.
321	2. the frontend runtime model should preserve publisher-specific optional fields instead of flattening everything into a blog schema.

672	---
673	
674	## 8. Key Risks
675	
676	### Risk 1: Blog Template Overfitting
677	
678	If implementation follows the reference repo too literally, the result will silently erase `courses` and `gallery` as first-class domains.
679	
680	Mitigation:
681	
682	- keep route prefixes explicit
683	- keep adapter API domain-aware
684	
685	### Risk 2: Dual Source Of Truth
686	
687	If the frontend uses both metadata JSON and a separate content collection index as peers, drift will eventually appear.
688	
689	Mitigation:
690	
691	- metadata JSON for lists
692	- markdown files for details
693	- optional collection tooling only as an internal helper, never as a competing source of truth
694	
695	### Risk 3: Exported HTML Handling
696	
697	Publisher may emit raw HTML image tags for sized embeds.
698	
699	Mitigation:
700	
701	- choose markdown renderer intentionally
702	- document controlled use of `rehype-raw`
703	- add rendering tests for actual exported samples
704	
705	### Risk 4: Asset Packaging On Deploy
706	
707	Next deployment must still expose `/assets/*` correctly.
708	
709	Mitigation:
710	
711	- test packaging locally before removing Astro
712	- keep asset sync as a deterministic prebuild fallback
713	
714	---
715	
716	## 9. Decision Record
717	
718	### Final Recommendation
719	
720	Migrate to Next.js 15, but do it as a contract-preserving frontend replacement, not as a template transplant.
721	
722	### Concrete Decisions
723	
724	1. Keep `tools/publisher` and `content/public` unchanged.
725	2. Preserve `/notes`, `/courses`, `/gallery` route families.
726	3. Use metadata JSON as list-page source of truth.
727	4. Use generated markdown files as detail-page source of truth.
728	5. Use a markdown-first renderer; do not force MDX-first architecture.
729	6. Treat `guangzhengli/nextjs-blog-template` as a UI and App Router reference, not as the content architecture.
730	
731	### Suggested Next Implementation Order
732	
733	1. bootstrap Next shell
734	2. build typed content adapter
735	3. migrate notes routes
736	4. generalize to courses and gallery
737	5. port template UI shell
738	6. add TOC, SEO, feeds, comments
739	7. remove Astro
740

Listens on port 3001 by default. Uses `powershell.exe` as shell for child processes.

## Key Architecture Summary

The pipeline flow is:

```
Obsidian Vault (external)
  -> tools/publisher (scans vault, parses frontmatter, rewrites links/assets, exports)
  -> content/public (generated markdown, assets, metadata JSON)
  -> apps/web (Next.js 15 reads content/public via typed adapter)
  -> Vercel (deploys apps/web)
```

The Obsidian plugin and publish-server.js provide an optional GUI/API layer for triggering export, preview, and deploy from within Obsidian.

Current content: 5 notes exported, 0 courses, 0 gallery items. The site is at Phase 3+ of the migration (route migration complete, markdown presentation working).

# Personal Site 文档

个人网站项目文档，基于 Obsidian → Publisher → Next.js → Vercel 的发布流水线。

## 文档目录

| 文档 | 说明 |
|------|------|

## 架构概览

\```
Obsidian Vault (外部)
  │
  ├─ tools/publisher ──────────────┐
  │   解析 frontmatter              │
  │   重写链接和资源                │
  │   生成 metadata JSON            │
  │                                 ▼
  │                       content/public/
  │                         ├─ notes/*.md
  │                         ├─ courses/*.md
  │                         ├─ gallery/*.md
  │                         ├─ assets/*
  │                         └─ metadata/*.json
  │                                 │
  │                       apps/web ─┘
  │                         Next.js 15 读取 content/public
  │                         渲染为静态页面
  │                                 │
  └─ Vercel ◄───────────────────────┘
      部署 apps/web
\```

# 快速开始

## 环境要求

- Node.js >= 18
- pnpm >= 10
- Obsidian (用于内容管理)
- Git

## 安装

\```bash
# 克隆仓库
git clone <repo-url>
cd personal-site

# 安装依赖
pnpm install
\```

## 首次运行

### 1. 导出内容

\```bash
# 从 Obsidian 导出文章到 content/public
pnpm export:content
\```

### 2. 本地预览

\```bash
# 启动 Next.js 开发服务器
pnpm dev:web
# 访问 http://localhost:3000
\```

### 3. 构建生产版本

\```bash
pnpm build:web
\```

## 可用脚本

| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `pnpm dev:web` | 启动 Next.js 开发服务器 |
| `pnpm build:web` | 构建生产版本 |
| `pnpm lint:web` | 运行 ESLint |
| `pnpm test:web` | 运行测试 |
| `pnpm export:content` | 从 Obsidian 导出内容 |
| `pnpm publish-server` | 启动发布 API 服务器 |

## Obsidian 插件安装

\```bash
# 复制插件到 Obsidian
cp -r tools/obsidian-frontmatter-plugin/dist/* \
  "<你的 Obsidian Vault>/.obsidian/plugins/frontmatter-helper/"
\```

在 Obsidian 中：设置 → 第三方插件 → 启用 "Frontmatter Helper"。

# 发布工作流

## 完整流程

\```
1. Obsidian 写作
   └─ 使用插件添加 frontmatter

2. 导出内容
   └─ node tools/publisher 或插件命令

3. 本地预览
   └─ pnpm dev:web

4. 部署上线
   └─ vercel --prod 或插件命令
\```

## 详细步骤

### Step 1: 在 Obsidian 中写作

在 Obsidian Vault 中编写 Markdown 文章。无需手动添加 frontmatter，使用插件一键添加。

**目录结构对应关系：**

| Obsidian 目录 | area 标签 | type 标签 | 内容类型 |
|---------------|----------|----------|---------|
| 01-研究项目 | area/research | type/reference | note |
| 02-课程学习 | area/course | type/course | course |
| 03-知识库 | area/knowledge | type/reference | note |
| 04-方法论 | area/method | type/method | note |
| 05-社团活动 | area/activity | type/activity | note |
| 06-创作 | area/creative | type/artwork | artwork |
| 07-归档 | area/archive | type/reference | note |
| 08-个人 | area/personal | type/reference | note |

### Step 2: 添加 Frontmatter

**方式 A：使用 Obsidian 插件（推荐）**

1. 打开命令面板 `Ctrl+P`
2. 输入 "添加 Frontmatter"
3. 插件自动推断标题、标签、摘要

**方式 B：批量脚本**

\```bash
node tools/add-frontmatter.js \
  --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault" \
  --include "04-方法论/科研交流与方法论"
\```

**Frontmatter 模板：**

\```yaml
---
title: "文章标题"
publish: true
content_type: note
channels:
  - site
summary: "文章摘要"
tags:
  - area/research
  - type/reference
  - focus/topic
---
\```

### Step 3: 导出内容

\```bash
cd tools/publisher
npm run export -- --config config.yaml
\```

导出结果在 `content/public/`：
- `notes/*.md` — 笔记
- `courses/*.md` — 课程
- `gallery/*.md` — 作品
- `assets/*` — 图片资源
- `metadata/*.json` — 内容索引

### Step 4: 本地预览

\```bash
pnpm dev:web
# 访问 http://localhost:3000
\```

### Step 5: 部署

\```bash
vercel --prod
\```

## Obsidian 插件一键流程

启动发布服务器后，可在 Obsidian 中完成全部操作：

\```bash
# 终端中启动服务器
node tools/publish-server.js
\```

然后在 Obsidian 命令面板中：
1. **导出内容到网站** — 触发 publisher
2. **启动本地预览** — 启动 dev server
3. **部署到 Vercel** — 一键部署

## 添加新文章到发布范围

编辑 `tools/publisher/config.yaml`，在 `include` 列表中添加目录：

\```yaml
public_scope:
  include:
    - "08-个人/DKU相关"
    - "04-方法论/科研交流与方法论"
    - "01-研究项目/git"
    - "01-研究项目/linux"
    - "01-研究项目/gui agent"
    - "03-知识库/新目录"        # 新增
\```

然后为该目录下的文章添加 frontmatter（`publish: true`），重新导出即可。

```

# 工具详解

## 1. Publisher (`tools/publisher/`)

从 Obsidian Vault 导出文章到 `content/public/`。

### 功能

- 扫描配置的 Vault 目录
- 解析 frontmatter（支持 CRLF/LF）
- 过滤 `publish: true` 且 `channels` 包含 `site` 的文章
- 重写 Obsidian 内部链接 `[[链接]]` 为网站路由
- 复制并重写图片资源路径
- 生成 metadata JSON 索引
- 为微信/小红书生成社交渠道草稿

### 配置

`tools/publisher/config.yaml`：

\```yaml
vault_root: "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault"
public_scope:
  include:
    - "08-个人/DKU相关"
    - "04-方法论/科研交流与方法论"
  exclude:
    - "08-个人/私密笔记"
output_root: "../../content/public"
default_channel: "site"
\```

### 使用

\```bash
cd tools/publisher
npm run export -- --config config.yaml
\```

### 运行测试

\```bash
cd tools/publisher
npm test
\```

---

## 2. Publish Server (`tools/publish-server.js`)

轻量 HTTP API 服务器，供 Obsidian 插件调用。

### 端点

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| POST | `/api/export` | 运行 publisher 导出 |
| POST | `/api/preview` | 管理 dev server（body: `{action: "start"/"stop"/"status"}`）|
| POST | `/api/deploy` | 运行 `vercel --prod` |
| GET  | `/api/status` | 查询服务器状态 |

### 启动

\```bash
node tools/publish-server.js
# 或
pnpm publish-server
\```

默认端口 3001，可通过 `--port` 修改。

### 测试

\```bash
# 检查状态
curl http://localhost:3001/api/status

# 触发导出
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/export

# 启动预览
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/preview \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"start"}'
\```

---

## 3. Add Frontmatter (`tools/add-frontmatter.js`)

批量为 Obsidian 笔记添加 frontmatter 的 CLI 工具。

### 功能

- 自动从文件名/标题推断 `title`
- 根据目录结构推断 `content_type` 和 `tags`
- 从正文第一段推断 `summary`
- 支持 `--dry-run` 预览模式
- 支持 `--force` 覆盖已有 frontmatter

### 使用

\```bash
# 扫描整个 Vault
node tools/add-frontmatter.js --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault"

# 只处理特定目录
node tools/add-frontmatter.js \
  --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault" \
  --include "04-方法论/科研交流与方法论"

# 预览模式（不写入文件）
node tools/add-frontmatter.js \
  --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault" \
  --include "01-研究项目/git" \
  --dry-run

# 覆盖已有 frontmatter
node tools/add-frontmatter.js \
  --vault "E:/Mywork/Obsidian Vault" \
  --include "08-个人/DKU相关" \
  --force
\```

### 参数

| 参数 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|------|------|--------|
| `--vault` | Obsidian Vault 路径 | 必填 |
| `--include` | 只处理指定目录（相对于 vault） | 全部 |
| `--exclude` | 排除指定目录 | 无 |
| `--dry-run` | 只打印不写入 | false |
| `--force` | 覆盖已有 frontmatter | false |

```

# Obsidian 插件 — Frontmatter Helper

## 安装

\```bash
# 构建插件
cd tools/obsidian-frontmatter-plugin
npm install
npm run build

# 复制到 Obsidian
cp dist/main.js dist/manifest.json \
  "<Vault 路径>/.obsidian/plugins/frontmatter-helper/"
\```

在 Obsidian 中：设置 → 第三方插件 → 启用 "Frontmatter Helper"。

## 命令

| 命令 | 快捷键建议 | 说明 |
|------|-----------|------|
| 添加 Frontmatter | `Ctrl+Shift+F` | 自动推断并添加 |
| 添加 Frontmatter (自定义) | — | 打开自定义对话框 |
| 切换发布状态 | `Ctrl+Shift+P` | 切换 publish true/false |
| 导出内容到网站 | — | 调用 publisher |
| 启动本地预览 | — | 启动 Next.js dev server |
| 部署到 Vercel | — | 一键部署 |

## 自动推断规则

### 标题

1. 从第一个 `# 标题` 提取
2. 若无标题，使用文件名（去掉 `.md`）

### 标签

根据目录结构自动推断：

\```
01-研究项目/git/Git教程.md
→ tags: [area/research, type/reference, focus/git]
\```

### 摘要

取正文第一段非空、非标题文本，截断到 100 字符。

### 内容类型

| 目录关键词 | content_type |
|-----------|-------------|
| notes | note |
| courses | course |
| gallery | artwork |

## 设置

在 设置 → Frontmatter Helper 中配置：

| 设置项 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|--------|------|--------|
| 默认发布状态 | 新文章的 publish 值 | true |
| 默认内容类型 | 新文章的 content_type | note |
| 默认发布渠道 | 新文章的 channels | ["site"] |
| 自动推断标签 | 根据路径推断 tags | true |
| 自动推断摘要 | 根据内容推断 summary | true |
| 摘要最大长度 | 自动摘要字符上限 | 100 |
| 服务器地址 | Publish Server URL | http://localhost:3001 |

## 发布命令说明

导出、预览、部署三个命令需要 **Publish Server** 运行中：

\```bash
# 先启动服务器
node tools/publish-server.js

# 然后在 Obsidian 命令面板中使用发布命令
\```

## 自定义 Frontmatter 对话框

使用 "添加 Frontmatter (自定义)" 命令时，弹出对话框可编辑：

- 标题
- 发布状态（开关）
- 内容类型（下拉）
- 发布渠道（复选框）
- 摘要
- 标签（逗号分隔）

```

# 部署指南

## Vercel 部署

### 首次配置

1. 安装 Vercel CLI：
   \```bash
   npm i -g vercel
   \```

2. 登录：
   \```bash
   vercel login
   \```

3. 在项目根目录关联项目：
   \```bash
   vercel link
   \```

### 部署

\```bash
# 生产部署
vercel --prod

# 预览部署
vercel
\```

### Vercel 配置

`vercel.json`：

\```json
{
  "buildCommand": "cd apps/web && npm run build",
  "outputDirectory": "apps/web/.next",
  "framework": "nextjs",
  "installCommand": "npm install"
}
\```

### 环境变量

当前无需额外环境变量。如需添加：

\```bash
vercel env add VARIABLE_NAME
\```

## 自定义域名

1. 在 Vercel Dashboard 中进入项目设置
2. 进入 Domains 页面
3. 添加自定义域名
4. 按提示配置 DNS 记录

## GitHub Actions 自动部署

推送到 `main` 分支时自动部署（需在 Vercel Dashboard 中配置 Git 集成）。

手动 CI 配置见 `.github/workflows/`（当前为占位文件）。

## 本地构建验证

部署前建议本地验证：

\```bash
# 导出内容
pnpm export:content

# 构建
pnpm build:web

# 本地预览构建结果
cd apps/web && npx serve .next
\```

```

### 2. App Structure: `apps/web/`

---

### 3. Content Loading Pipeline

This is the core data flow. The content adapter lives at `src/lib/content/`:

**Types** (`src/lib/content/types.ts`):
- `ContentKind` = `"notes" | "courses" | "gallery"`
- `ContentListItem` -- has `kind`, `slug`, `title`, `summary`, `tags`, `cover`, `updated`, `course`, `week`, `artCategory`, `series`
- `ContentDocument` extends `ContentListItem` adding `body` (markdown string), `created`, `contentType`

**Path resolution** (`src/lib/content/paths.ts`):
- Computes `publicRoot` by walking up from the source file to `repoRoot/content/public`
- `getMetadataPath(kind)` -> `content/public/metadata/{kind}.json`
- `getDocumentPath(kind, slug)` -> `content/public/{kind}/{slug}.md`

**Index loading** (`src/lib/content/load-index.ts`):
- Reads `content/public/metadata/{kind}.json` via `fs.readFile`
- Parses JSON, normalizes each item with `normalizeListItem()`
- Filters items that have both `slug` and `title`
- Sorts alphabetically by title using `zh-CN` locale

**Entry loading** (`src/lib/content/load-entry.ts`):
- First calls `loadIndex()` to get metadata
- Finds the matching slug in the index
- Reads the markdown file from `content/public/{kind}/{slug}.md`
- Parses frontmatter from the markdown using `parseFrontmatterDocument()`
- Calls `normalizeDocument()` which **merges metadata index fields with frontmatter fields**, with metadata taking priority

**Frontmatter parsing** (`src/lib/content/frontmatter.ts`):
- Custom parser (uses `js-yaml`'s `load()`) that splits on `---\n` delimiters
- Returns `{ frontmatter, body }`

**Normalization** (`src/lib/content/normalize.ts`):
- `normalizeListItem()` -- safe string/array extraction from raw metadata JSON
- `normalizeDocument()` -- combines index metadata + frontmatter + body into a `ContentDocument`

**Key pattern**: The JSON metadata files are the **source of truth for list pages**. The markdown files are the **source of truth for detail page body content**. Frontmatter in the markdown provides supplementary fields (`created`, `content_type`) but the index metadata wins for fields like `title`, `summary`, `tags`.

### 4. Markdown Rendering Pipeline

**File**: `E:\Mywork\algorithm\personal-site\apps\web\src\lib\markdown\pipeline.ts`

Uses the `unified` ecosystem with this plugin chain:
1. `remark-parse` -- parse markdown
2. `remark-gfm` -- GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, strikethrough, etc.)
3. `remark-math` -- math expressions (`$...$` and `$$...$$`)
4. `remark-rehype` -- convert to rehype (with `allowDangerousHtml: true` for raw HTML from publisher)
5. `rehype-raw` -- parse inline HTML
6. `rehype-slug` -- add `id` attributes to headings
7. `rehype-highlight` -- syntax highlighting for code blocks
8. `rehype-katex` -- render math with KaTeX
9. `rehype-stringify` -- serialize to HTML string

The `MarkdownBody` component (server component) calls `renderMarkdownToHtml()`, then `extractTocFromHtml()` from `src/lib/toc.ts`, and renders both the HTML article and a sticky sidebar TOC.

**Note**: `react-markdown` is listed in `package.json` dependencies but is **not actually imported or used anywhere** in the codebase. The rendering pipeline uses `unified` directly.

### 10. Key Architectural Patterns

1. **Static-only site**: Every page uses `force-static` and `generateStaticParams()`. No ISR, no SSR, no API routes.

2. **Two-source content model**: List pages read from JSON metadata files; detail pages read markdown files and merge metadata on top.

3. **Publisher contract boundary**: `content/public/` is the handoff point. The frontend never reads the Obsidian Vault directly. The publisher is the only tool that touches source content.

4. **Server components by default**: Most components are server components. Client components (`"use client"`) are limited to interactive UI: nav menus, TOC scroll tracking, go-to-top button, sheet overlay, and Giscus comments.

5. **No search infrastructure exists**: This is a clean starting point if search needs to be added -- there are no partial implementations or search-related code to refactor.

8	export async function loadEntry(kind: ContentKind, slug: string): Promise<ContentDocument | null> {

12	  if (!metadata) {
13	    return null;
14	  }

20	  } catch (error) {

22	      return null;

1	import type { ContentDocument, ContentKind, ContentListItem } from "./types";

3	type RawMetadata = Record<string, unknown>;
4	type RawFrontmatter = Record<string, unknown>;
5	
6	function asString(value: unknown): string | null {
7	  return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 ? value : null;
8	}
9	
10	function asStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
11	  return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string") : [];
12	}
13	
14	export function normalizeListItem(kind: ContentKind, raw: RawMetadata): ContentListItem {

18	    title: asString(raw.title) ?? "",
19	    summary: asString(raw.summary) ?? "",
20	    tags: asStringArray(raw.tags),

25	    artCategory: asString(raw.art_category),
26	    series: asString(raw.series),
27	  };

31	  kind: ContentKind,
32	  rawMetadata: RawMetadata,
33	  rawFrontmatter: RawFrontmatter,
34	  body: string,

1	import { load } from "js-yaml";
2	
3	export type ParsedFrontmatterDocument = {
4	  frontmatter: Record<string, unknown>;
5	  body: string;
6	};
7	
8	export function parseFrontmatterDocument(source: string): ParsedFrontmatterDocument {
9	  if (!source.startsWith("---\n") && !source.startsWith("---\r\n")) {
10	    return { frontmatter: {}, body: source };
11	  }
12	
13	  const normalized = source.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
14	  const endMarker = "\n---\n";
15	  const endIndex = normalized.indexOf(endMarker, 4);
16	
17	  if (endIndex === -1) {
18	    return { frontmatter: {}, body: normalized };
19	  }
20	
21	  const rawFrontmatter = normalized.slice(4, endIndex);
22	  const body = normalized.slice(endIndex + endMarker.length).trim();
23	  const parsed = load(rawFrontmatter);
24	  const frontmatter =
25	    parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)
26	      ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>)
27	      : {};
28	
29	  return { frontmatter, body };
30	}
31
```

1	export type TocItem = {
2	  id: string;
3	  text: string;
4	  level: number;
5	};
6	
7	export function extractTocFromHtml(html: string): TocItem[] {
8	  const toc: TocItem[] = [];
9	  const headingRegex = /<h([1-6])[^>]*id="([^"]*)"[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h[1-6]>/gi;
10	
11	  let match;
12	  while ((match = headingRegex.exec(html)) !== null) {
13	    const level = parseInt(match[1], 10);
14	    const id = match[2];
15	    const text = match[3].replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "").trim();
16	
17	    if (id && text) {
18	      toc.push({ id, text, level });
19	    }
20	  }
21	
22	  return toc;
23	}
24	
25	export function extractTocFromMarkdown(content: string): TocItem[] {
26	  const toc: TocItem[] = [];
27	  const lines = content.split("\n");
28	
29	  for (const line of lines) {
30	    const match = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/);
31	    if (match) {
32	      const level = match[1].length;
33	      const text = match[2].trim();
34	      const id = text
35	        .toLowerCase()
36	        .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "")
37	        .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
38	        .replace(/-+/g, "-")
39	        .trim();
40	
41	      if (id && text) {
42	        toc.push({ id, text, level });
43	      }
44	    }
45	  }
46	
47	  return toc;
48	}

19	export function GiscusComments({
20	  repo,
21	  repoId,
22	  category,
23	  categoryId,
24	  mapping = "pathname",
25	  term,
26	  reactionsEnabled = true,
27	  emitMetadata = false,
28	  inputPosition = "top",
29	  lang = "zh-CN",
30	  loading = "lazy",
31	}: GiscusCommentsProps) {

34	  useEffect(() => {
35	    if (!containerRef.current) return;
36	
37	    const container = containerRef.current;
38	
39	    const script = document.createElement("script");
40	    script.src = "https://giscus.app/client.js";
41	    script.setAttribute("data-repo", repo);
42	    script.setAttribute("data-repo-id", repoId);
43	    script.setAttribute("data-category", category);
44	    script.setAttribute("data-category-id", categoryId);
45	    script.setAttribute("data-mapping", mapping);
46	    if (term) script.setAttribute("data-term", term);
47	    script.setAttribute("data-strict", "0");
48	    script.setAttribute("data-reactions-enabled", reactionsEnabled ? "1" : "0");
49	    script.setAttribute("data-emit-metadata", emitMetadata ? "1" : "0");
50	    script.setAttribute("data-input-position", inputPosition);
51	    script.setAttribute("data-theme", "light");
52	    script.setAttribute("data-lang", lang);
53	    script.setAttribute("data-loading", loading);
54	    script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
55	    script.async = true;
56	
57	    container.innerHTML = "";
58	    container.appendChild(script);
59	
60	    return () => {

62	    };
63	  }, [repo, repoId, category, categoryId, mapping, term, reactionsEnabled, emitMetadata, inputPosition, lang, loading]);

1	const fs = require("fs");
2	const path = require("path");
3	
4	const REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, "..", "..", "..");
5	const PUBLIC_ROOT = path.join(REPO_ROOT, "content", "public");
6	const OUTPUT_PATH = path.join(__dirname, "..", "public", "feed.xml");
7	
8	const SITE_URL = "https://personal-site.vercel.app";
9	const SITE_NAME = "Personal Site";
10	const SITE_DESCRIPTION = "Public publishing pipeline preview site.";
11	
12	function loadMetadata(kind) {
13	  const filePath = path.join(PUBLIC_ROOT, "metadata", `${kind}.json`);
14	  const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
15	  return JSON.parse(content);
16	}
17	
18	function escapeXml(str) {
19	  return str
20	    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
21	    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
22	    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
23	    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
24	    .replace(/'/g, "&apos;");
25	}
26	
27	function generateItem(item, kind) {
28	  const pubDate = item.updated
29	    ? new Date(item.updated).toUTCString()
30	    : new Date().toUTCString();
31	
32	  return `    <item>
33	      <title>${escapeXml(item.title)}</title>
34	      <link>${SITE_URL}/${kind}/${item.slug}</link>
35	      <guid isPermaLink="true">${SITE_URL}/${kind}/${item.slug}</guid>
36	      <description>${escapeXml(item.summary || "")}</description>
37	      <pubDate>${pubDate}</pubDate>
38	      <category>${kind}</category>
39	    </item>`;
40	}
41	
42	function generateFeed() {
43	  const notes = loadMetadata("notes");
44	  const courses = loadMetadata("courses");
45	  const gallery = loadMetadata("gallery");
46	
47	  const allItems = [
48	    ...notes.map((item) => ({ ...item, kind: "notes" })),
49	    ...courses.map((item) => ({ ...item, kind: "courses" })),
50	    ...gallery.map((item) => ({ ...item, kind: "gallery" })),
51	  ].sort((a, b) => {
52	    const dateA = a.updated ? new Date(a.updated) : new Date(0);
53	    const dateB = b.updated ? new Date(b.updated) : new Date(0);
54	    return dateB.getTime() - dateA.getTime();
55	  });
56	
57	  const itemsXml = allItems
58	    .map((item) => generateItem(item, item.kind))
59	    .join("\n");
60	
61	  const feed = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
62	<rss version="2.0" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
63	  <channel>
64	    <title>${escapeXml(SITE_NAME)}</title>
65	    <link>${SITE_URL}</link>
66	    <description>${escapeXml(SITE_DESCRIPTION)}</description>
67	    <language>zh-CN</language>
68	    <lastBuildDate>${new Date().toUTCString()}</lastBuildDate>
69	    <atom:link href="${SITE_URL}/feed.xml" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/>
70	${itemsXml}
71	  </channel>
72	</rss>`;
73	
74	  const outputDir = path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH);
75	  if (!fs.existsSync(outputDir)) {
76	    fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });
77	  }
78	
79	  fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_PATH, feed, "utf8");
80	  console.log(`Feed generated at ${OUTPUT_PATH}`);
81	  console.log(`Total items: ${allItems.length}`);
82	}
83	
84	generateFeed();
85
